selection_rule: interface-valid candidates are judged by the LLM on who/when/what; the first accepted candidate with the best LLM score is frozen

sysadmin_10.failure_analysis: No blocking failures. The who pattern is all-to-all (excluding self), which is slightly broad but plausible given unknown directed graph structure and multi-step propagation. The when condition exactly matches machine_status==0, correctly selecting unhealthy senders; rollout evidence confirms that edges are activated only for those senders (observed when_edge_rate ≈0.5). The what mask selects only the two relevant features per sender, keeping messages sparse and task-relevant.
